h: Weeping in Concealment and Joy in Divine Rule

p: into three of calamity and seven of consolation
corresponds to the seven lower middos
אִיתָא בַּתִּיקּוּנִים בְּפֶתַח אֵלִיָּהוּ (תִּיקּוּנֵי זֹהַר, הַקְדָּמָה יז, א)
it is stated in the Tikkunim, in Pesach Eliyahu (Tikkunei Zohar, Introduction 17a):
"And about these two it is written:
'The hidden things belong to Hashem our God'" (Devarim 29:28);
is the intellect hidden from all thought,
"'My soul shall weep in secret places' (Yirmiyahu 13:17)
HaKadosh Baruch Hu has a place,
strength and joy are in His place'?
this is in the inner chambers,
that is in the outer chambers."
And the Maharsha, of blessed memory,
are the inner hidden places," etc.;
At first glance it should have been
"strength and joy are in His place,"
which correspond to the seven days of Creation,
for the creation and governance of the world
But in the three upper ones,
which are "the hidden things belonging to Hashem our God,"
the term "place" does not apply there,
for there it is in the aspect of Ein Sof.
And even though regarding the seven lower ones
"Blessed is the glory of Hashem from His place,"
there is no one who knows it"
that is because in every middah,
since it is comprised of all ten,
it is also fitting to say
But in the three upper ones themselves,
שָׁם אֵין שַׁיָּיךְ שֵׁם מָקוֹם כְּלָל
the name "place" does not apply at all.
"My soul shall weep in secret places
and they said in the Gemara:
and given to the nations of the world.
Because of the pride of the Kingdom of Heaven";
for the governance of this world,
only Hashem Yisbarach is the One who governs,
"'And I will set My throne in Eilam
and destroy from there king and princes' (Yirmiyahu 49:38)
And in truth the essence of the world
only "the world follows its natural course,"
the governance was handed over to them, chas v'shalom;
Hashem Yisbarach is the One who governs,
וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה סוֹבֵל הַיִּשְׂרָאֵל צַעַר
and because of this a Jew suffers pain.
But in the World to Come
the three hidden upper ones will be revealed,
and then they will recognize and know
and You are He since the world was created";
that even after the world was created
Hashem Yisbarach is the One who governs,
as before the world was created;
the three hidden ones are concealed,
which is a semblance of the World to Come,
a semblance of the World to Come;
"On the day that Hashem gives you rest," etc.,
that there is a feeling in the heart of a Jew
even though he is still in the hard labor,
that only Hashem Yisbarach is the One who governs.
הוּא רַק עַל יְדֵי מִדַּת אֱמוּנָה
is only through the middah of faith:
that on Shabbos a Jew believes
that everything is from Hashem Yisbarach,
and he has a feeling of this in the heart.
But the hidden things are concealed,
for there have not yet been revealed explicitly
that it should be "You are He"
as before the world was created.
And this is "My soul shall weep in secret places":
which are the three upper ones,
so that we merit the revelation of the hidden things,
which are the three upper ones,
as it will be in the World to Come.
And this is "My soul shall weep in secret places
because of the pride of Yisrael,
as though it was given to the nations of the world;
and likewise because of the pride
And this is so as long as
the three hidden upper ones have not been revealed.
that were emanated for the governance of this world,
בֶּאֱמֶת מַלְכוּתוֹ בַּכֹּל מָשָׁלָה (תְּהִלִּים קג, יט)
in truth "His kingdom rules over all" (Tehillim 103:19):
"And I will set My throne in Eilam";
only that so His wisdom, may He be blessed, decreed
and therefore "strength and joy are in His place."
"And in the outer chambers there is not?
"The destruction of the Beis HaMikdash is different,
for even the angels of peace wept."
That is: at the time of the Churban,
that is, in the seven lower ones,
that, chas v'shalom, there was taken
and given to the nations of the world.
(בְּמִדְרָשׁ רַבָּה אֵיכָה פֶּרֶק א, אֵיכָה רַבָּה א, נא)
(in Midrash Rabbah Eichah, chapter 1, Eichah Rabbah 1:51);
and Yisrael received a complete receipt,
(בְּמִדְרָשׁ רַבָּה שְׁמִינִי פָּרָשָׁה יא, וַיִּקְרָא רַבָּה יא, ז)
וְהָיָה כַּאֲשֶׁר נִלְכְּדָה יְרוּשָׁלַיִם (יִרְמְיָה לח, כח)
"'And it came to pass when Yerushalayim was captured' (Yirmiyahu 38:28)
even this is not a calamity,
only so that the soul of Mashiach would be born.
"strength and joy are in His place."
And corresponding to the seven middos
are the seven haftaros of consolation.
which are the three upper ones,
they have not yet been revealed
as they will be revealed in the future,
And in this world they are concealed,
"hidden things belonging to Hashem our God,"
the pride of Yisrael was taken, etc.

p: He further wrote in Sefer Otzar HaKavod,
and so it is brought in the Maharsha from an old sefer,
And this is according to what we find
that it calls the second meal of Shabbos
for it reckons the three holinesses:
Binah includes all three upper ones,
That is: the beginning of fear
עַל מִי שֶׁאֵין בּוֹ יִרְאַת שָׁמַיִם
about one who has no fear of Heaven:
that the King of kings of kings,
(as is written at the beginning of Orach Chaim);
each time more into the heart,
will be explicit in the heart,
and it will be as though it stands
"'Yet all this is worth nothing to me'
all the treasures of that wicked one
indicates as one pointing with a finger;
and when it is engraved on his heart,
it is as though it is explicit
And this is called "Binah is the heart":
that the King of kings of kings,
HaKadosh Baruch Hu, stands before him.
And similar to what we find (Berachos 28b):
"May the fear of Heaven be upon you
like the fear of flesh and blood";
that is, that he see Him explicitly.
is there not a level higher than this?
that this too is a level.
"If you seek it like silver," etc.,
"then you will understand the fear of Hashem"
that it enter the depths of the heart
And there are forty-nine gates of Binah,
of Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
which was revealed to Rabbi Akiva,
"and you will find the knowledge of God":
that he will merit the aspect of Daas.
is that it joins Chochmah and Binah;
and Daas is the inner dimension of Keser Elyon.
from the crown of the yud,
from Keser Elyon to the yud,
and as is written in Rashi
And this is what is said (Mishlei 2:10):
and knowledge will be pleasant to your soul."
"Wisdom" is the Chochmah of the mind,
what one grasps with the intellect;
and when it enters from the mind
into the depths of the heart,
then he merits the aspect of Daas,
which is the inner dimension of Keser Elyon.
And therefore the third middah is called Binah,
and it is also the aspect of Daas,
which includes all three upper ones.
And this is what it says in the holy Zohar
that this meal is called "the upper Shabbos,"
and it is "the meal of Atika"

p: when it is engraved in the heart
it is as if explicit before the eye,
and then it includes all three,
and through this one can rectify
which correspond to the three upper ones,
for at this meal of Atika,
we say it in the language of Targum,
which is the aspect of the "back"
and this too is called seeing,
And so we say "His glory," bikareih,
"And may He show us His secrets"
(according to the version he himself said)
these are "the hidden things belonging to Hashem our God,"
and they are concealed in this world.
what is being gestured to him by a sign," etc.;
"What did he gesture to you?" etc.,
regarding one who strengthens the power of his agent;
and the Rashbam explained in his second explanation
a kind of strengthening of power.
And this is "And may He show us His secrets."
which is the middah of Malchus,
in which is the life of all,
"bound in the bundle of life with Hashem your God";
this is the Shabbos of Erev Shabbos,
which is the middah of Malchus;
and as is written in Sefer HaBahir
that from there all the souls fly forth.
"And may it rise up to the head"
which is the aspect of Keser Elyon,
that is, that the hidden things be revealed.
